query: Which components will incorporate differential privacy, what target privacy budgets (ε, δ) are acceptable, and how will we quantify the privacy–utility tradeoff for clinical tasks?

response.query: Which components will incorporate differential privacy, what target privacy budgets (ε, δ) are acceptable, and how will we quantify the privacy–utility tradeoff for clinical tasks?
response.answer: Differential privacy will be incorporated in data analysis tools; acceptable privacy budgets (ε, δ) are typically set between 0.1 and 1; the privacy-utility tradeoff is quantified using metrics like L2-sensitivity and empirical evaluation on clinical datasets.
